title: Backing Up an Opinion
grammar: Evidentials & Probability Particles (állítólag, biztosan, valószínűleg) in Argumentation
goal: I can back up an opinion with arguments and facts.
I can say what an argument and a piece of evidence are.
I can say which evidence or fact I mean, using amit or amelyet.
